Filmmaker's documentary trailer about Elon Musk released

A trailer for the upcoming documentary film 'Musk', directed by Alex Gibney, has been released. The film, which focuses on businessman Elon Musk, is set to premiere at the 83rd Venice Film Festival. One report highlights the filmmaker's claim that Musk is not a genius inventor but a 'stock pumper'. The documentary's trailer was released online ahead of its festival debut.
